records.title: Building the Taj Mahal
records.dateNote: The detailed UNESCO synthesis gives 1632–1648 for the mausoleum and 1653 for later additions. Its introduction instead starts in 1631. This record follows the synthesis and preserves that discrepancy for review.
records.summary: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.
records.locationNote: UNESCO's property reference point, rounded to five decimal places.

citations.locator: Outstanding Universal Value → Brief synthesis, first paragraph; compare introductory description
citations.supports: Patron, purpose and construction chronology, with an internal start-year discrepancy; property coordinates provide location.

records.title: Shah Jahan's patronage at Agra

records.summary: The Mughal emperor's architectural patronage is represented here by the Taj Mahal project.
records.locationNote: The commissioned monument's reference point, not the ruler's location, capital boundary or imperial territory.

citations.locator: Outstanding Universal Value → Brief synthesis, first paragraph; property coordinates
citations.supports: Shah Jahan's patronage and its association with the Taj Mahal construction window and site.
